en: Colorized historic postcard showing a central square with a grand town hall building featuring a tall clock tower and green roof, a baroque column or monument in the foreground with horse‑drawn carriages around it, and other surrounding buildings and trees. The caption beneath the image reads in Hungarian. The reverse side is blank with standard postcard dividing line and address lines.
